responsibility: Declares the lowering visitors responsible for Rust expressions that own statement blocks. These adapters translate AST block, unsafe block, if/if-let, loop, while, for, match, and other ExprWithBlock forms into their corresponding HIR block-oriented nodes while tracking whether control flow terminates so enclosing statements and blocks can mark unreachable tails or unit requirements. The file separates plain block lowering, if-family lowering, and generic block-expression dispatch into dedicated visitors that insert the resulting HIR expressions into the mapping tables.
